title: Preference Optimization for Reasoning with Pseudo Feedback
authors_zh: Fangkai Jiao、Geyang Guo、Xingxing Zhang、Nancy F. Chen、Shafiq Joty、Furu Wei（南洋理工大学、微软研究院、A*STAR I2R、佐治亚理工学院、Salesforce Research）
paper_type_zh: 伪反馈偏好数据构造与推理优化研究
best_for_zh: 适合缺少专家标注、但拥有可执行或可核对答案测试的推理任务开发者。
one_line: PFPO constructs preference pairs for math and code reasoning by evaluating sampled solutions against frontier-generated or self-consistent pseudo test cases.
PFPO 通过在前沿模型生成或自一致伪测试用例上评估采样解答，为数学与代码推理构造偏好回答对。
why: It makes the test case, pass score, and pair-margin rule explicit training objects rather than assuming a human preference label already exists.
inclusion_reason: It turns pseudo test outcomes into chosen-rejected solution records and directly optimizes a reasoning policy on those records.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Preference optimization for reasoning normally assumes gold answers, human labels, or curated unit tests. Those signals are scarce for difficult mathematics and programming problems, while simply choosing a frequently sampled final answer does not extend cleanly to programs that must work across many inputs.

PFPO asks how unlabeled reasoning prompts can yield executable preference pairs. It reformulates solution labeling as testing: a candidate solution is evaluated against one answer check or a set of input-output cases. The central training object is therefore not an unexamined model response, but a response paired with a pseudo test score and a comparison rule.

推理的偏好优化通常假定存在标准答案、人工标签或精心整理的单元测试。这些信号在困难数学和编程问题中很稀缺，而仅选择被频繁采样的最终答案，又无法自然扩展到必须在许多输入上工作的程序。

PFPO 询问，无标签推理提示如何产生可执行的偏好回答对。它把解答标注重述为测试：候选解答接受一个答案检查或一组输入—输出用例的评估。因此，核心训练对象不是未经检验的模型回答，而是带有伪测试分数和比较规则的回答。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
For a task with one checkable final answer, a stronger model can provide a pseudo answer, or the policy's repeated samples can provide a majority answer. For programming, PFPO first obtains test inputs, generates multiple candidate programs, executes them, and takes the most frequent output for each input as a pseudo expected output. This generalizes self-consistency from one answer to a suite of tests.

The policy then samples solutions and receives the fraction of pseudo tests passed. A winner need only pass enough tests and exceed a loser by a margin, which avoids requiring every pseudo test to be perfect. These scored solutions become outcome preference pairs; the same feedback can also rank continuations from a reasoning prefix for process preference training.

对于只有一个可核对终答的任务，较强模型可以提供伪答案，或策略的重复采样可以提供多数答案。对于编程，PFPO 先获得测试输入，生成多个候选程序，执行它们，并将每个输入下最频繁的输出当作伪期望输出。这把自一致性从一个答案推广到一套测试。

策略随后采样解答，并得到通过伪测试的比例。优选解答只需通过足够多测试并以一定差距超过劣选解答，因而不要求每条伪测试都完美。这些带分数的解答成为结果偏好回答对；相同反馈也可以为推理前缀后的续写排序，用于过程偏好训练。

title: Method
方法
html:
PFPO represents a task by test pairs. It samples N solutions, executes or extracts their answers, and assigns a pass rate. For outcome DPO, it retains pairs whose winner clears a quality threshold and beats the loser by a score margin. Frontier feedback uses a stronger model to obtain pseudo answers or help create test inputs; self-feedback instead uses policy-generated solutions and majority-voted outputs, permitting iterative construction.

The authors apply the procedure to mathematical reasoning and code. Their released implementation contains PFPO configuration, data processing, execution, and training code. Reported math runs include Mathstral-7B and Llama-3.1-8B; code runs use DeepSeek-Coder-7B-v1.5. They compare SFT, ordinary DPO, prefix DPO, frontier-feedback PFPO, and successive self-feedback iterations.

PFPO 用测试对表示一个任务。它采样 N 个解答，执行或提取其答案，并赋予通过率。对于结果 DPO，它保留优选解答超过质量阈值且在分数差距上胜过劣选解答的回答对。前沿反馈用更强模型获得伪答案或辅助创建测试输入；自反馈则使用策略生成的解答和多数投票的输出，从而允许迭代构造。

作者将该过程应用于数学推理和代码。其发布的实现包含 PFPO 配置、数据处理、执行与训练代码。报告的数学实验包括 Mathstral-7B 和 Llama-3.1-8B；代码实验使用 DeepSeek-Coder-7B-v1.5。它比较 SFT、普通 DPO、前缀 DPO、前沿反馈 PFPO 和连续的自反馈迭代。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
For Mathstral-7B, the paper reports MATH accuracy rising from 58.3 to 68.6 after SFT, frontier-feedback PFPO, and two self-feedback iterations; GSM8K moves from 85.6 to 90.3 and College Math from 34.3 to 42.2. For Llama-3.1-8B, repeated self-feedback reaches 57.8 on MATH, versus 53.8 after its SFT stage.

On LiveCodeBench, DeepSeek-Coder-7B-v1.5 rises from 21.1 to 24.6 after the reported frontier-feedback and two self-feedback iterations. On APPs it rises from 15.4 after SFT to 19.1 in the reported iterative setting. These results support the claimed record-construction route across answer checking and executable multi-test programming, but do not prove pseudo feedback is correct on every generated test.

对于 Mathstral-7B，论文报告在 SFT、前沿反馈 PFPO 和两次自反馈迭代后，MATH 准确率从 58.3 提升至 68.6；GSM8K 从 85.6 升至 90.3，College Math 从 34.3 升至 42.2。对于 Llama-3.1-8B，重复自反馈在 MATH 上达到 57.8，而其 SFT 阶段后为 53.8。

在 LiveCodeBench 上，DeepSeek-Coder-7B-v1.5 在报告的前沿反馈和两次自反馈迭代后从 21.1 升至 24.6。在 APPs 上，报告的迭代设置从 SFT 后的 15.4 升至 19.1。这些结果支持该记录构造路径能够覆盖答案检查和可执行的多测试编程，但并未证明伪反馈在每条生成测试上都正确。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
The closest self-consistency methods use majority answers to filter or select solutions in tasks with a single answer. PFPO changes the data contract by treating every reasoning problem as a testable interface and extending majority voting to outputs of multiple generated programs on multiple inputs. This makes a test score, rather than a bare consensus answer, the source of a preference relation.

It also does not require a winner to pass every pseudo test. The quality threshold and winner-loser margin explicitly acknowledge that synthetic tests can be imperfect. That decision lets the same pseudo-feedback object feed outcome DPO, process preference construction, and iterative self-improvement rather than serving only as an inference-time selector.

最接近的自一致性方法使用多数答案在只有一个答案的任务中筛选或选择解答。PFPO 通过将每个推理问题视作可测试接口，并把多数投票扩展到多个生成程序在多个输入上的输出，改变了数据契约。这使测试分数而非裸露的共识答案成为偏好关系的来源。

它也不要求优选解答通过每一条伪测试。质量阈值和优选—劣选差距明确承认合成测试可能并不完美。该决策让同一伪反馈对象能够供给结果 DPO、过程偏好构造和迭代自我改进，而不只充当推理时选择器。

title: Limitations
局限
html: PFPO's central assumption is that a frontier model or a majority of sampled programs produces useful pseudo tests. Correlated model errors can make a wrong output dominant, while limited or weak test inputs allow an incorrect program to pass. Frontier-feedback construction also costs stronger-model calls, and iterative self-feedback can amplify an early policy bias. The paper reports strong task metrics but no broad audit of pseudo-test validity, provenance, or contamination.
PFPO 的核心假设是，前沿模型或多数采样程序能产生有用的伪测试。相关的模型错误可能使错误输出占多数，而有限或较弱的测试输入会让错误程序通过。前沿反馈构造还需要更强模型调用，迭代自反馈可能放大早期策略偏差。论文报告了强任务指标，但没有对伪测试有效性、来源或污染进行广泛审计。

title: Usefulness
用途
html: Use PFPO when a task can be expressed as answer checks or executable input-output tests and expert labels are the scaling bottleneck. The critical implementation work is not only DPO: retain pseudo test provenance, all candidate outputs, pass rates, and the thresholds used to create each pair. Re-evaluate winners against held-out human or trusted tests before treating the pseudo score as a reliable reward signal.
当任务可以表示为答案检查或可执行的输入—输出测试，且专家标签是扩展瓶颈时，可以使用 PFPO。关键实现工作不只是 DPO：应保留伪测试来源、所有候选输出、通过率和用于构造每个回答对的阈值。在把伪分数当作可靠奖励信号之前，应使用留出的人工或可信测试重新评估优选解答。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html: Read the pair criterion before the benchmark tables: PFPO's actual supervision unit is a solution plus a pseudo-test score and margin, not a model response selected by popularity alone. Then separate frontier feedback from self feedback, because their costs and error sources differ. Finally, inspect code evaluation by difficulty; the overall LiveCodeBench gain does not mean the method equally improves the small hard subset.
应在阅读基准表之前先看回答对准则：PFPO 实际的监督单元是解答加伪测试分数和差距，而不是仅凭受欢迎程度选出的模型回答。随后区分前沿反馈和自反馈，因为二者的成本与错误来源不同。最后检查按难度划分的代码评估；整体 LiveCodeBench 提升并不意味着该方法同样改善了较小的困难子集。
